question:
Create a new KiCad project named b18 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Create the schematic for the Djinn Rev2a keyboard's mechanical bottom plate. Include eleven plated 3.2 mm M3 mounting holes, all on one GND net, one reset-button cutout, two Djinn logo instances and two Djinn name/version artwork instances. Use the supplied DjinnFootprints mounting-hole/logo/name footprints and reversible-kicad-footprints PushButton_4.5mm_Cutout. Artwork and cutout items have no electrical connections; represent them with suitable mechanical/graphic symbols. No keyboard electronics or reset switch circuit belongs on this plate. Exact board outline and hole coordinates are outside this schematic task.
Local dependencies: Use the project-local footprint libraries in lib/ under the project directory (Djinn-Rev2a/reversible-kicad-footprints.pretty and Djinn-Rev2a/DjinnFootprints.pretty); use standard KiCad libraries for everything else.
